description: Source code for the VideoDmpReader class, which handles reading and parsing video dump (DMP) files, extracting access units, and providing media sample information.

classes.name: VideoDmpReader
classes.description: Class responsible for reading and parsing video dump files, managing access units, and providing media sample info.

classes.name: VideoDmpReader::Registry
classes.description: Singleton registry for caching DMP file info.

classes.description: Represents an audio access unit read from the DMP file.

classes.name: VideoDmpReader::VideoAccessUnit
classes.description: Represents a video access unit read from the DMP file.

methods.description: Template function to calculate the average bitrate of access units.
